content.text:
All 18 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position:

**Deviations requiring redlines (6) — all validated:**

| Rule | Issue | Our edit |
|---|---|---|
| **EXCLUSIVITY** (high) | §2.2 makes Vendor our sole and exclusive hosted-analytics provider for the full term, no performance exit — walk-away, and contradicts §§2.1 and 12.3 | Delete |
| **LD** (high) | §7.6 imposes uncapped USD 25,000/day liquidated damages on us for any dependency delay — walk-away | Replace with schedule relief plus Vendor's documented additional costs |
| **AUDIT** (medium) | §22.1 allows unlimited, unannounced audits with remote access to our systems — walk-away, and contradicts §22.2 | Annual, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, records-based, no system access |
| **RENEWAL** (medium) | §8.2 auto-renews on a 180-day non-renewal window — worse than walk-away | Shorten to 30 days, add 60-day Vendor reminder (§8.3 uplift cap is fine) |
| **NOSOLICIT** (medium) | §12.4 binds only us, 18 months post-termination, all Vendor personnel ever, bars "engaging" (a de facto no-hire), no advertising carve-out | Narrow to mutual/12-month/involved-personnel with carve-outs |
| **MFN** (medium) | §7.2 obliges us to give Vendor our best supplier terms — wrong direction, open-ended | Delete |

**Missing clause (1):** **T4C** — §9 has no convenience right at all in a three-year term (§8.1). We inserted a new §9.6 giving us 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund keyed to §10.2, and confirming Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term.

**Compliant (11):** LOL-CAP, INDEMN, NONCOMPETE, GOVLAW, ASSIGN, IP, LICENSE, WARRANTY, INSURANCE, MINCOMMIT, TRANSITION.

Two structural notes worth raising with Vendor: the document contains **duplicate numbering** (two §2.2s and two §7.2s), and in each pair the problematic clause is the inserted one that conflicts with the surrounding drafting — §2.2 (exclusivity) against §§2.1/12.3, §7.2 (MFN) against §12.3, and §22.1 against §22.2. That internal inconsistency supports deletion rather than negotiation on the exclusivity, MFN and audit points.
